item.title: Rallying Cry – November 7, 2026
item.description: A Pakistani startup won big in Silicon Valley, a teen’s fight to end period stigma earned a Diana Award, and Singaporeans are saving money (and food waste) with bargain groceries—plus Nigeria’s clean energy push just hit 160 CNG stations.
